Group Order – Allergen Alerts
New
Group Order Diner Customer Allergen Alerts
  • Diners can save their allergen information once to their profile, and it automatically follows them on every Group Order — no re-entry needed.
  • The alert appears across every vendor-facing touchpoint: the Chef Dashboard, physical food labels, the PDF order summary, and the order manifest.
  • Vendors are required to confirm they have reviewed all allergen alerts. Confirmations are logged for audit and incident resolution.
  • New feature modal (GO Web & Mobile): a one-time popup explains the Allergen Alert feature. It shows for both new and existing users when they log in.
📘 Open the Allergen Alerts Internal Training Guide
GO Web
Update
Cart Open by Default & Checkout Reminder
  • The cart is now open by default on the ordering page.
  • New copy reminds users to proceed to checkout, so they don’t miss that step.
New
New GO FAQ Page
A new FAQ page for diners that includes:
  • General Group Order ordering FAQs
  • Allergen Alerts — including how to set one on your order from your GO profile settings (choose one or more approved allergens, then tap Save Profile; it applies to every order after that and can be updated or cleared anytime), how food partners see it, and how it differs from Dietary Preferences
  • The onboarding video showing how to place an order — the same one in the welcome email
Chef Documents (PDFs)
Update
Dietary Grouping, Kitchen Prep Ticket & Modifier Pricing
  • Order Manifest: items are now regrouped into dietary sections (e.g., Vegan, Vegetarian, Prepared Without Gluten) instead of one unsorted list, to reduce cross-contamination during batch cooking.
  • Kitchen Prep Ticket: a new document that replaces the Order Summary in the cutoff email, putting allergen and special-request context up front. The Order Summary is still available on the Chef Dashboard.
  • Order Summary: now shows modifier pricing inline, so food partners can see what they are paid for each pick.
  • Only presentation and delivery of the documents changed — no changes to the underlying order data.
Update
“Chef Notes” Renamed to “Special Request”
The diner’s typed note is now labeled Special Request everywhere it appears, so it is no longer confused with the internal Vendor Note that the FPM team sets on a menu item. Label changes only — data and behavior are unchanged.
  • Order Manifest and Food Labels: “Vendor Notes:” is now “Special Request:”.
  • Order Summary / Food Partner Order Form: “Customer Special Requests:” is now “Special Request:”.
  • Admin – Group Order location settings: the “Uses Chef Notes?” checkbox is now “Uses Special Requests?”.
  • The Order Summary’s existing “Vendor Notes:” line is unchanged, and Food Labels still never show the Vendor Note.
